texts.text:
<它就那么凭空出现，杀了默尔索。甚至还堵死了出口，让我们逃不出去……>
 <It just appeared out of nowhere and killed Meursault. It even blocked off the way out so we couldn't escape...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<那种东西到底为什么会在百货公司里徘徊……？>
 <Why would something like that even be wandering around a department store...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……抱歉，我们在说什么来着？
 ... Sorry, what are we talking about?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<就是啊，我们刚才遇到的那个东西，它是……>
 <You know, that entity we just encountered, it was...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……既不是扭曲，也不是异想体。
 ... was neither a Distortion nor an Abnormality.

可是……我也没有十足把握，该不该真的称它为……
 And yet... I couldn't say with any confidence whether I should really call it...

哦，拜托。你不能把大伙儿的好奇心都勾起来了，然后话说一半就没了，经理老兄。
 Oh, come on. You can't get us all curious and then just trail off like that, Manager Bud.
texts.speaker:
格里高尔
 Gregor

texts.text:
<我是说那个背上钉满了尖钉的怪物。>
 <I'm talking about that monster with all those nails driven into its back.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
这样的存在……在我们抵达那间洗手间之前，从未进入过我的视野。
 Such a being... had never once entered my sight prior to our arrival at the restroom.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
……但丁，你要是没劲儿了就多歇会儿呗？反正我们已经找到默尔了，所以……
 ...Dante, why don'tcha rest a little longer if you're outta juice? We found Meur already, so...
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
罪人们一直忧心忡忡地瞟着我时钟的指针。等他们终于走开后，我径直去找默尔索，问他到底是怎么回事。
 The Sinners kept casting worried glances at the hands of my clock. Once they finally moved away, I went straight to Meursault and asked him what was going on.

<刚才到底发生了什么，默尔索？你——>
 <What the hell happened just now, Meursault? Do you—>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……我确实记得，经理。
 ... I do remember, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
回答您的问题——其他罪人之所以对发生的事毫无记忆，是因为我们被"送回"了。
 To answer your question, the reason the other Sinners have no memory of what occurred is because we were "returned."
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<"送回"……？>
 <"Returned"...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
意思是，大百货商场被重置回了某个特定选择尚未做出之前的时间点。
 It means that the Grand Magasin was reset to a point before a particular choice was made.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
这似乎是大多数人都无法察觉的现象。然而您和我，似乎是例外。
 This appears to be a phenomenon that most are incapable of perceiving. You and I, however, appear to be exceptions.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<好吧，先把那个放一边……那到底是什么导致了这次重置……？>
 <Okay, fine, putting that aside... what caused the reset in the first place...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
它很可能是想让您做出不同的选择。
 It likely wanted you to make a different choice.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……因为您先前做出的选择，并未被锁链所束缚。
 ... Because the choice you made before was not bound in chains.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
在我们出发之前，我大概该花点时间整理一下思绪。
 I should probably take a moment to collect my thoughts before we head out.

那个存在为什么会出现……
 Why did that entity appear...

……我们又为什么会被送回来……？
 ... and why were we sent back...?

<我就有这种预感……果不其然，我们又回到这儿了。>
 <Had a feeling this would happen... and sure enough, we're back here.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<等等，这让我很纳闷……明明死的只有默尔索，为什么我们其他人也会被一起拖回洗手间？>
 <Wait, this makes me wonder... Why do the rest of us get dragged back to the restroom when Meursault is the only one who dies?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
因为我是象征所绑定的主体。因此，当我死亡时，您和其他罪人似乎也会一并被送回这间洗手间，经理。
 Because I am the subject to which the symbol is bound. Therefore, when I die, it would appear that both you and the other Sinners are returned to this restroom as well, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
那怎么，这下我们成什么鬼魂了？
 So what, that makes us some kinda ghosts now?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
……那样归类并不准确。不过，如果这有助于您理解，将其视为鬼魂也没有实际上的问题。
 ... That would be an inaccurate classification. However, if it aids your understanding, there is no practical issue with regarding it as such.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
如果这套机制真是这样运作的……那么视情况而定，它或许具有战术价值。
 If that is indeed how this mechanism operates... then it may have tactical value, depending on the circumstances.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
战术价值……？
 Tactical value...?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
确实如此。值得留意的是，无论境况如何，我们的路途似乎终究都会将我们带回这间茅厕。
 Indeed. What bears note is that, regardless of circumstance, our course appears certain to return us unto this privy.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
正是如此。若我们陷入无法脱身的绝境，或路线彻底迷失……这便可以作为一种撤退手段。
 Precisely. If we are cornered beyond reasonable escape, or our route becomes irretrievably lost... this could serve as a means of withdrawal.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
我是真心希望我们……别开始把这当成什么逃生通道。
 I'd really prefer if we... didn't start treating this like an escape route.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
<是啊……可不能养成习惯。不过万一情况真的糟到没救，至少得记得还有这条路可选。>
 <Yeah... let's not make a habit of it. But if things get bad enough, we should at least remember it's an option.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante
